history.prompt: 首屏人像要放大上半身，内容要左右自适应对齐，减少冗余的内容，合理调整排版布局等
changes: hero portrait replaced by an upper-body crop (assets/model-upper.png) scaled up
one shared rail (--stage-w / --rail) aligns every section's left and right edge
removed the hero arc, the hero store badges, the hero photo plate, the ticker band and the duplicate footer link column
lookbook demoted from a floating button to a secondary text action beside the single primary CTA
product grid reduced to one uniform 4:5 frame; section rhythm and type scale retuned
hero type given a hard 12px floor (--t-min) and split into --u (type) / --g (geometry) units

history.prompt: 请调整首屏人物居中腿部以上的上半身，而不是只有头部，页面宽度尽量撑开自适应占满页面，各个区域调整合适的间距和对齐，不要紧凑在一起
changes: hero is now a fluid full-width band (no locked aspect-ratio) sized in svh; the page fills the viewport at every width
the portrait is centred on the page's middle line and shows the whole upper body (head to hips, nothing clipped); the crop's head-forward composition is compensated with translate -62%
one fluid rail (--rail) plus a full-width content shell aligns every band's left and right edge (spread 0 at 1600 / 1366 / 1280 / 1024 / 420)
the sticky topbar was deleted so the hero nav is the only navigation; the nav gained Drop / Weaves / Lookbook
section rhythm opened up: 7rem band padding, wider grid gaps and list spacing, social proof stacked so the gown never touches it
the product grid stays three columns above the 1366x768 baseline (no re-layout above the baseline, per SKILL.md rule 17)

history.prompt: 首屏人物放大并只展示腿部以上，头部遮挡上方部分标题文字；把原本堆在左侧的按钮组移到右侧，让左右内容分布平衡。
changes: hero figure 改为 top 定位、高度 min(142svh, 84cqw)、水平居中；透明全身素材在画布底被裁到大腿，头顶进入标题带并靠 z-index 压住部分字母
hero__actions 从 hero__lede 中拆出，绝对定位到右侧同一 30svh 基线并垂直右对齐；左侧保留 eyebrow/文案与 100K+ 证明，右侧承接两个动作与 Scroll Down
窄屏 flex 单列补 order 4/5 与横排按钮，保持原有渐隐与单列节奏

history.prompt: 左侧文字改为在左侧垂直居中；100K+ Happy Customers 与头像组移到右下角右对齐，Scroll Down 相应让到左下角避免冲突。
changes: hero__lede 由 top:30svh 改为 top:50% + translate:0 -50%，在左侧垂直居中并保持左对齐
hero__customers 由 left:var(--rail) 改为 right:var(--rail)、align-items:flex-end、text-align:right，落到右下角
hero__scroll 由 right:var(--rail) 改为 left:var(--rail)，让出右下角；窄屏补 text-align:left 重置
桌面与 420×900 窄屏均复核：五组元素两两无碰撞、按钮与滚动交互正常
